The Promise

Experience teaches. Insight transforms.

We communicate every day. But knowing what to say is one thing. Understanding how communication works, how meaning is created and how people respond is another.

The Communication Intelligence Mentorship is a selective professional development experience for individuals seeking to grow beyond technical competence into stronger professional judgement, self-awareness, confidence and leadership effectiveness.

Drawing on over three decades in broadcasting, media, leadership and strategic communication, J. Ayo Makinde brings practical experience, personal insight, guided reflection and honest feedback to a structured mentorship journey.

The goal is not simply to become a better communicator, but a more intelligent, responsible and effective one.

This programme is delivered in two tracks:

01Track One

Track One: Media & Communication Mentorship

Beyond the craft. Towards professional excellence.

Who it's for:

Emerging and mid-career broadcasters, presenters, producers, media creatives, podcast hosts and communication professionals.

Technical competence can open doors. But professional judgement, credibility and the ability to understand people often determine how far a career progresses.

This track helps participants strengthen their professional identity, navigate industry realities and develop the communication intelligence needed for sustained relevance and growth.

Participants explore:

  • ◆Career direction, professional identity and positioning
  • ◆Editorial judgement, interviewing and purposeful storytelling
  • ◆Communication intelligence, ethics and professional responsibility
  • ◆Presentation, audience understanding and engagement
  • ◆Professional relationships, credibility and influence
  • ◆Career transitions, challenges and emerging opportunities

Expected Outcome

A clearer professional direction, stronger communication judgment, and a personalised development roadmap, supported by practical feedback on selected work.

02Track Two

Track Two: Leadership Communication Mentorship

Beyond authority. Towards understanding and influence.

Who it's for:

Emerging leaders, managers, entrepreneurs, executives and professionals preparing for greater leadership responsibility.

Beyond setting direction, leadership is also about what people understand, how they interpret expectations and what they ultimately do.

This track helps participants understand how communication shapes leadership behaviour, relationships, trust and organisational performance.

Participants explore:

  • ◆Human Communication Intelligence and Self-awareness
  • ◆Leadership communication and emotional intelligence
  • ◆Understanding others without necessarily agreeing with them
  • ◆Navigating difficult conversations, conflict and relationships
  • ◆Building credibility, trust and responsible influence
  • ◆Turning leadership intentions into shared understanding and coordinated action

Expected Outcome

Greater awareness of personal communication patterns, stronger leadership judgement and a practical development plan for improving communication effectiveness.

Our Mentorship Philosophy

Communication Intelligence. Responsibility. Effectiveness.

01

Intelligence: Understand.

Recognise how communication works, how people create and interpret meaning, and how communication influences relationships, decisions and behaviour.

02

Responsibility: Own the Process.

Communicate deliberately, listen attentively, consider consequences, verify understanding and take responsibility for improving how meaning is shared.

03

Effectiveness: Make It Count.

Apply communication intelligence and responsible judgement to strengthen understanding, relationships, professional performance and meaningful outcomes.

Our conviction: Communication responsibility does not end when the message is delivered.

The Mentorship Experience

The Mentorship Experience

Duration

12 weeks

Format

Primarily virtual, with opportunities for in-person engagement

Cohort Size

Maximum of 10 participants per track

The programme combines personal mentoring, guided conversations, practical exercises, reflection and individual feedback.

Each Participant Receives

01

An initial communication and professional development assessment

02

Eight facilitated small-group mentoring sessions, including practical clinics

03

Two individual 45-minute mentoring conversations with J. Ayo Makinde

04

Practical assignments and personalised feedback

05

A personal 90-day development roadmap

06

Access to a scheduled and moderated peer learning community throughout the programme

The Development Journey

The Development Journey

01

Discover

Understand your current communication patterns, professional strengths, development needs and aspirations.

02

Deepen

Explore communication intelligence, responsible judgment, and the realities of professional growth through guided mentorship conversations.

03

Demonstrate

Apply new understanding to practical professional challenges and receive constructive feedback.

04

Develop

Consolidate your learning into a personal development roadmap with clear priorities for continued growth.

Private Mentorship

A More Personal Journey

For professionals seeking more in-depth individual guidance, a limited number of private mentorship spots will be available.

Duration

Three months

Format

Six individual mentoring sessions with J. Ayo Makinde

Each engagement is tailored to the participant's professional aspirations, communication challenges and development priorities.

It includes agreed development goals, guided reflection, practical feedback and a personalised growth plan.

Selection and Participation

Selection and Participation

The Communication Intelligence Mentorship is designed for people who are intentional about their professional development.

Admission will be selective, based on professional aspirations, identified development needs and willingness to participate actively.

Participants are expected to engage openly, undertake practical assignments, reflect on feedback and take responsibility for their development.

The programme is an investment in personal and professional growth, not a promise of employment, promotion or access to professional opportunities.

The Invitation

Your Next Level Requires More Than What You Know.

It requires greater awareness of yourself, a deeper understanding of others and the judgment to communicate with clarity, responsibility and purpose.
